name: Version 1
description: Initial public release of FLOW.AI featuring interactive yoga guidance, real-time posture analysis, voice feedback, and privacy-first browser-based practice.
features: Watch & Learn mode with animated visual guidance
Practice Mode with real-time webcam posture analysis
Live voice feedback for posture correction
Smart hold timer that only counts when the pose is correct
Priority-based posture corrections for easier learning
10 built-in yoga poses across beginner and intermediate levels
Privacy-first browser-based processing with no user accounts
lessonsLearned: Integrating MediaPipe Pose for posture detection
Designing responsive and accessible user interfaces
Developing modular and extensible yoga pose architecture
